proposed_mixed_main.protected_work: Distinguish conductive and buoyancy-driven energy routes in an apparatus where a material change and a flow intervention give different observations.
proposed_mixed_main.first_attempt: A sealed box has two identical-temperature hot plates on insulating feet. Plate A touches a metal rail that reaches the cool wall; plate B has no rail. A fan changes the steady power needed for both plates, but removing A's rail reduces only A's required power. Explain the two interventions and why a single material property cannot explain both results. Propose a matched control.
proposed_mixed_main.predict: Predict whether removing the rail and switching the fan off necessarily affect the same energy path.
proposed_mixed_main.reconstruct: Rail supplies a conductive bypass; fan changes external convection; steady input measures total loss, not a unique component. Compare rail present/absent and fan on/off at matched face temperatures, supports and surroundings. Radiation remains a possible path.
